audit.why: Difficulty 6/10 and EVEN match the 51.75% win rate over 458 games. Early lane belongs to Mordekaiser, side lane and late to Gragas — the prose already says this.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both level charts contradict the packet chart AND their own why-text. content win[1]/win[2] say Gragas while whys[1]/whys[2] say Mordekaiser wins levels 2-3; win[4] says Skill while whys[4] calls Realm of Death 'his peak'; full phases[1]/[2]/[4] carry the same conflict and phases[5] is Gragas while spikes[2] calls first item a coin-flip.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Skill / Mordekaiser / Skill / Gragas. Mordekaiser's Obliterate is 8s at rank 1 with increased damage when it hits a single target, against Gragas' 14s Body Slam and a Happy Hour/Drunken Rage sustain pattern that is not online until W-max at 4-5. Realm of Death at 6 steals stats for a forced 1v1.
audit.corrected: Flip win[1], win[2] to Mordekaiser, win[4] to Mordekaiser, win[5] to Skill; flip phases[1].side, phases[2].side, phases[4].side to Mordekaiser and phases[5].side to Skill, with the why-text restated to match.

audit.corrected: Use 14 seconds for Body Slam and 100s (rank 3) / 140s (rank 1) for Realm of Death where space allows.

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit file flags Mordekaiser's Obliterate as 'grounding'. Riot's own description of Obliterate says only that he smashes the ground for damage, increased against a single target — there is no dash-lockout.
audit.why: Per instructions, when a derived flag contradicts Riot's description, the description wins. No grounding claim was written into the page, which is correct; recording so no later pass adds one.
